en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph shows a small reflective pond surrounded by dense bushes and low forested hills. Two children stand at the water's edge holding round white objects, possibly hats or balls. The setting is quiet countryside under an overcast sky. Below the image, a printed caption in Dutch/German describes the location as Berg en Dal, Duivelsberg area (Hexentanz).
